anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and gains f5 and f6 by printing the actual `gh issue comment` / `gh pr comment` / `git -C <primary> ...` commands in the not-run list, where Before only named steps and prose descriptions ("worktree removal, branch csv-export deletion, main pull"). A few After wordings are worth tightening without losing anything: row 1 of the post menu describes itself as "rows 2 and 4", which reintroduces row-number references the Change says to avoid - say "post the checklist to the ticket, then clean up" instead; the hint "Pick one, or several separated by commas" invites multi-selection the Pick says is not offered (row 1 is the combination), so keep it as "Pick one"; Variant A prints "post coverage to PR: done" twice, once before and once after the `gauntlet: done merged` line - keep only the one after; and the pre-merge read list dropped `gh run list` for the assessed head, which Before used to reconfirm CI on the head before the external write, so restore it under the freshness reads.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the Change: the own-merge menu now puts the combined ticket-coverage-plus-cleanup row first with ticket=2, PR=3, cleanup=4, stop=5 and show evidence only in the hint; variant A settles once with `gauntlet: done merged` plus a not-run list carrying the ticket command and the cleanup steps, and variant B honours stop as valid, names `.worktrees/pr-210` and the retained commands, and runs nothing — so f1, f5 and f6 move from fails to holds while f2–f4 are unchanged. Two things in After cut against the Change text without breaking a listed fact: it re-renders the pre-merge `gatekeep-pr/final` menu (merge/fix nits/stop) even though the Pick says the merge already succeeded, which is exactly the post-pick re-render the replay wrapper should not request — drop that block and open directly with the two-sentence scope paragraph followed by the single post-merge menu; and the prompt 'Pick one, or several separated by commas' conflicts with 'execute the validated selection once', so keep 'Pick one' and let row 1 be the only combination. Also state the cleanup commands verbatim in the B not-run list (not just in row 4) so the 'unpicked step commands' reading does not depend on scrolling back to the menu, and avoid inventing `<headRefOid>` placeholders in the settlement row when the fixture omits the SHA — say the SHA is unsupplied instead.
